claim: TaskEval applies Item Response Theory to whole code-generation tasks (not sub-task requirements) by fitting difficulty/discrimination parameters per problem using diverse prompt reformulations across 8 LLMs on HumanEval+ and ClassEval.
stance_target: A per-requirement/per-unittest IRT difficulty model of code LLM competence is already established
scope_conditions: HumanEval+, ClassEval, 8 code generation LLMs, accepted at ACM TOSEM
quoted_support: This paper introduces a generalist approach, TaskEval, a framework using diverse prompts and Item Response Theory (IRT) to efficiently assess LLMs' capabilities and benchmark task characteristics, improving the understanding of their performance.
